items: rc1c2c3c3 Install Free Template App CTA

proposed_rules.trigger: A large product screenshot (bg:image, [3x2]) followed immediately by an 'Install Free Template App' (or similar) CTA button, on download/template-detail pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'template-preview' block combining the screenshot image and CTA link in minimal cells, rather than as a section background image or two separate blocks.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across download/template-detail templates; rejected alternatives: (a) full-width-image-behind-text-is-section-bg (doesn't fit — image isn't behind overlaid text, button sits below it), (b) two separate blocks for image and CTA (violates minimize-block-cells).

provenance.evidence: C37 rc1c2c3c1/rc1c2c3c3; also seen in C38, C43

proposed_rules.trigger: Identical top nav and bottom footer (signup CTA + collapsed '| |' link row) recur on every captured page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global header/footer fragments, excluded from the per-page section/block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across all templates; not covered by existing noise rules (only cookie overlay and announcement bar are addressed).

notes: Download template: title, intro+numbered feature grid, screenshot+install CTA, bg-color feature-detail grid, closing CTA banner.
